title: Cornflake Crunch
description: Crunchy squares of caramelised cornflakes bound with condensed milk. Incredibly moreish party food for children and adults alike.

ingredients.text: 1 x 397g tin of sweetened condensed milk

steps: Line a large baking tray (32cm x 25cm) with greaseproof paper.
Heat the sugar in a saucepan over medium heat until it caramelises (5–10 minutes). Don't stir — swirl the pan instead.
Crush the cornflakes slightly between your fingers in a bowl.
Add the condensed milk to the caramelised sugar — it may solidify but keep stirring over heat until dissolved and golden (up to 15 minutes).
Pour over the cornflakes, mix well with a wooden spoon, tip into the tin and press down.
Set aside to cool before cutting into squares.
notes: Makes 25 squares. Per square estimate. Can use Rice Krispies or Crunchy Nut Cornflakes instead.
